races.name: Bet £20 Get £20 With Unibet Apprentice Handicap (London Stayers' Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Saratoga Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with consistent recent placed form but hasn't won for three years, relies on strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: On losing run but mark is in range & shaped okay on his return; drying ground would help
runners_data.spotlight: Multiple winner at up to 1m6f, including here but hasn't won for almost three years; even so, has been placed on five successive occasions and is capable of going close from this mark now back on this surface.

runners_data.name: Tarbat Ness
runners_data.note: Proven 2-mile stayer whose AW wins came on Tapeta, needs to prove effectiveness on this Polytrack surface
runners_data.comment: All five wins at 2m; latest fourth (2m, good) was close to his best; can't be ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Thorough stayer whose wins have all been at about 2m, his two AW successes coming on Tapeta; 4lb higher than the most recent of those and has each-way claims.

runners_data.name: Karthon
runners_data.note: Recently switched to Emma Lavelle, hold-up type stepping up significantly in trip with stamina to prove
runners_data.comment: 0-9; up in trip for stable debut after seven months off; each-way claims if ready to go
runners_data.spotlight: Formerly with Andrew Balding; has been placed at up to 12.5f in 5-10 starts; didn't appear to have any obvious excuses when beaten 7l when upped to this trip here latest; that's clearly not put connections off trying again and he's well treated on some of last year's form.

runners_data.name: Vilaine Verlaine
runners_data.note: Big step up from 1m2f to 2m creates stamina doubts despite Alicia Perkins' 5lb claim
runners_data.comment: Runner-up on AW last May but turf record is 0-9 and most turf form makes her opposable
runners_data.spotlight: 1m2f Polytrack winner; takes a big step up in trip for this and will certainly have stamina to prove, even if shrugging off an inauspicious start to the campaign.

runners_data.name: Further Measure
runners_data.note: Course winner in February, prominent style suits the likely pace scenario with proven stamina at this distance
runners_data.comment: Won over 2m at Kempton in February; returns from 84 days off and now drops back in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Prolific winner, mostly on AW and at 1m6f-2m, including C&D; 1lb higher than when scoring here in February; not quite as good in two subsequent starts but looks a player back up in trip and with the same claimer up as for that most recent success.

runners_data.name: Fleurman
runners_data.note: Course and distance winner in March, 1lb higher than that success with hold-up style requiring strong pace
runners_data.spotlight: Multiple winner, mostly at about 2m and is 1lb higher than when scoring over C&D in March; matched that effort back here next time, before a below-par effort on soft at Haydock latest; will be a player if bouncing back.

runners_data.name: Rogue Empire
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner, recent Lingfield winner facing 6lb rise but holds tactical advantage
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark at the eighth attempt with an authoritative performance in a 0-60 at Lingfield (2m, good) last month; 6lb rise looks fair and he has run well over this C&D; unexposed and warrants respect with 3lb being claimed.

runners_data.name: Individualiste
runners_data.note: Weak recent form in this code despite jumps success, very hard to recommend on current evidence
runners_data.comment: Pulled up both h'dle starts for this yard; visor on for belated h'cap debut in this sphere
runners_data.spotlight: Formerly with Paul Nicholls then Gavin Cromwell; has four jumps wins to his name; placed twice in this code at up to 1m5f but very hard to fancy on his form since joining his current trainer.

races.paceDynamic: Rogue Empire will dictate terms from the front with no other confirmed pace angles in this 8-runner field. Further Measure may press from a prominent position early, but the overall gallop will be steady and sustainable over this 2-mile trip. The lack of pace pressure means the leaders can control fractions, setting up a tactical finish where horses need to be well-positioned turning for home. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid a traffic-laden finish, while hold-up horses face the challenge of making up significant ground against a controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Rogue Empire gets an uncontested lead and Further Measure settles prominently without applying early pressure.
scenarios.body: The pace will be manageable throughout, allowing the leaders to kick clear in the straight while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from the back. Front-runners and prominent racers will dominate the finish with their positional advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly sedate and creates a bunched field turning for home.
scenarios.body: The lack of early tempo will compress the field, creating opportunities for hold-up horses with superior finishing kicks to sweep past tiring leaders. Strong stayers from the back will benefit from the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Further Measure or another prominent runner applies sustained pressure to Rogue Empire from halfway.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field and create a genuine test of stamina, suiting proven 2-mile performers over those stepping up in trip. Horses with proven stamina at this distance will prevail.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Rogue Empire goes too slow early then kicks too hard, creating a stop-start rhythm.
scenarios.body: The uneven tempo will favour horses with tactical speed who can respond to pace changes, while one-paced gallopers struggle with the rhythm shifts. Adaptable types with recent form will benefit from the messy pace.

watchPoints.text: Rogue Empire if he goes off too fast early, could compromise his stamina reserves for the finish
Further Measure for his positioning in the first half-mile, crucial he doesn't get caught wide tracking the leader
Vilaine Verlaine for how she handles the significant step up in trip on her first attempt at 2 miles
The pace through the first mile, if too slow it will set up a cavalry charge finish favouring hold-up horses
Saratoga Gold for his jumping from the back of the field, needs to be produced with a clear run

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Agent Rose
runners_data.spotlight: 28,000euros yearling, 90,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; seventh foal; half-sister to five winners including Mystical Dawn (1m 2yo; RPR 97), Tamam Desert (7f 2yo; 86) and Cosmic Soul (2m Flat including AW, 78; 2m1f/2m4f hurdle); dam 1m-1m2f winner (102); trainer 20% with AW 2yos (last five seasons); market check suggested.

runners_data.name: Dark Reign
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; unraced dam closely related to 1m1f Group 3 winner King Of Cities, half-sister to 6f Group 1 winner Inisherin, out of 1m2f Group 1 winning close relative of 1m Group 1 winner Triple Time; trainer 9% with AW 2yos (last five seasons); check the market for clues.

runners_data.name: Lady Caroline Lamb
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; sister to 1m 2yo winner Magic Trip (RPR 83); dam 1m4f/1m6f AW winner (78), half-sister to useful winners Galapiat (1m4f) and Madame Ambassador (1m2f Listed); trainer 17% with AW 2yos (last five seasons); market check suggested.

runners_data.name: Pequenita
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam French 1m-1m3f winner (including Group 2; RPR 111), sister to 1m6f Group 3 winner Master Of Reality, closely related to 1m4f Listed winner Chamonix; trainer 11% with AW 2yos (last five seasons); should be capable of a good showing on debut.

runners_data.name: Sunset Script
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; dam unraced sister to Listed-placed 1m3f winner Rouge Sellier, closely related to winners Lumiere (Cheveley Park) and Sheikha Reika (Canadian 1m2f Grade 1); check the betting.

runners_data.name: Rosevannion
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to three winners (best RPR 89); trainer 18% with AW 2yos (five seasons).
runners_data.spotlight: 14-1 for debut, when always prominent or leading until the final furlong and 4l fourth at Wolverhampton (7f, Tapeta); should be capable of building on that.

runners_data.name: Woodhay Wayfarer
runners_data.spotlight: 28-1 for debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month, when never better than midfield; needs a big step up on that.

runners_data.name: Virtue Charity
runners_data.spotlight: 40-1 for debut at Goodwood (6f, good) last month, when always behind and beaten 10l; much more needed.

runners_data.name: Guadalevin
runners_data.comment: The stable's 2yos have been going well, particularly on AW, so she rates a likely type
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to five winners, out of a 1m2f winner; well supported on debut when 9-4 and a close third at Southwell (7f, Tapeta); that's modest form but she should be better for the experience and could take a step up on it.

races.name: Unibet/EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Gypsy Jazz Queen
runners_data.note: Unraced Beckett filly with strong breeding may improve dramatically from debut appearance
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to 6f/7f AW winner Main Target (including 2yo; RPR 78); dam 1m-1m2f winner (including AW/Group 2; 113), half-sister to 1m2f Group 1 winner Izzi Top; dam won here; trainer 18% with AW 2yos; interesting newcomer.

runners_data.name: Salve Allegra
runners_data.note: Unraced King runner faces first start with headgear applied, trainer unfamiliar with surface
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; dam 7f-1m6f maiden, out of maiden half-sister to US 8.5f Grade 2 winner Salve Germania, is granddaughter of German Oaks winner; trainer not known for his AW 2yo winners; hooded on debut; best watched.

runners_data.name: Danseuse
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with solid Newcastle third form, suits tactical races over this trip
runners_data.comment: Looks the part on paper and yard is 21% in novice events this year
runners_data.spotlight: Supported on debut when 3-1 and showing promise in finishing 2l third at Newcastle (12.5f, Tapeta) last month; can improve on that and should be a player.

runners_data.name: Velvet Vega
runners_data.note: Strong Newmarket second form gives her clear experience edge, Murphy booking significant
runners_data.spotlight: Weak 9-2 for debut at Newmarket (1m2f, good) last month, when she showed signs of greenness but came 5l second of seven; that form looks very good in this context and she could prove tough to beat with any improvement.

runners_data.name: Tribal Queen
runners_data.note: Appleby-trained with quality breeding, showed promise when getting organized at Haydock debut
runners_data.comment: Well-bred Godolphin newcomer; leading trainer also saddles Kempton third Fashion's Fancy
runners_data.spotlight: Frankel half-sister to a 1m2f/1m4f winner (including Listed); 100-30 for debut at Haydock (1m2f, soft) last month, when slow to get going but getting the hang of things as the race went on and beaten under 3l; with improvement for that experience, she'll be a player.

runners_data.name: Persian Flaw
runners_data.note: Struggled badly when slow to start at Salisbury, needs major improvement
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to 1m4f AW winner Arazzo; dam 1m4f/1m6f winner; watch the betting on debut
runners_data.spotlight: 50-1 for debut at Salisbury (1m2f, good) last month when slowly away and never seriously involved; more needed.

runners_data.name: Sullom Voe
runners_data.note: Best of three Menuisier runners but fading tendency limits appeal in sprint finish
runners_data.comment: Never dangerous when eighth on her debut at Sandown 20 days ago; open to improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Looks the pick of the three saddled by this trainer and has shown some ability despite being ultimately well beaten at both Sandown and Salisbury (both 1m2f, good); likely to be of greater interest when entering handicaps.

runners_data.name: Palomezcal
runners_data.note: Well beaten in both starts at big odds, requires significant step forward
runners_data.comment: 150-1 when beating only one rival home at Sandown on her debut; one of three for her yard
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten at big odds in both starts; much more needed.

runners_data.name: Midnight Steppers
runners_data.note: Poor form in three attempts suggests watching brief only
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten at increasing odds in all three starts; watching brief advised.

races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runner and all nine runners showing hold-up tendencies, this shapes as a pedestrian early gallop where the field will bunch together through the middle stages. Gypsy Jazz Queen or Salve Allegra might reluctantly take up the running early but neither is a natural pace-setter, creating a tactical affair with plenty in contention turning for home. The lack of genuine pace will inevitably produce a sprint finish over the final three furlongs, heavily favoring horses with proven finishing kicks and tactical speed rather than sustained gallopers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely slow with no one willing to commit until late
scenarios.body: The field will arrive at the home turn in a bunch before exploding into a furious sprint, suiting horses with proven finishing kicks and race experience. Velvet Vega's Newmarket form gives her the strongest finishing credentials while Danseuse showed promise when third at Newcastle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Debutant Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the newcomers Gypsy Jazz Queen or Salve Allegra possess untapped ability
scenarios.body: Strong breeding and top connections could see one of the newcomers improve dramatically from their first public appearance. The tactical nature would suit patient rides on potentially well-bred types with more to offer.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Even Pace Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If someone maintains steady fractions without overly strong or weak early gallop
scenarios.body: Moderate but consistent pace would favor the more experienced runners who have shown form at the trip. Tribal Queen's Appleby stable form and breeding suggests she could benefit from a fair test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the Menuisier trio or Midnight Steppers finds dramatic improvement
scenarios.body: One of the lesser-fancied runners discovers significant progress in a weak maiden. The slow pace could bring them into contention despite poor previous efforts.

watchPoints.text: Velvet Vega's market position will reveal connections' confidence after her promising Newmarket second
Track any late support for unraced pair Gypsy Jazz Queen and Salve Allegra given strong stable form
Monitor early pace development as slow fractions will compress field and create chaotic finish
Menuisier's three runners all show fading tendencies which could be exposed in sprint finish
Jockey bookings Murphy and Buick suggest Velvet Vega and Tribal Queen are well-regarded by connections

races.name: Set Your Limits With Unibet Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Lady Manzor
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits if pace is strong, but cheekpieces removal and 21-day break add uncertainty
runners_data.comment: Triple Polytrack winner who has been in good form this spring; in the mix back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Handicapped to win and she ran creditably over C&D three weeks ago following a tardy start; cheekpieces left off today; not discounted.

runners_data.name: Bold Suitor
runners_data.note: Proven course winner whose hold-up style needs gaps, 9-year-old veteran may lack pace for sprint finish
runners_data.comment: Back on song when runner-up over C&D 16 days ago, so must enter calculations nudged up 1lb
runners_data.spotlight: C&D win last summer; best effort for some time when getting up late to beat Havana Touch by a nose at Lingfield six weeks ago (7f, AW); a 2lb rise shouldn't prevent another prominent showing.

runners_data.name: Silca Bay
runners_data.note: Friday's Goodwood winner racing again in 5 days with 7lb claimer, prominent style suits tactical race
runners_data.comment: Usual cheekpieces are back on after keeping on well for fourth at Salisbury
runners_data.spotlight: Three course wins last year; off the mark on turf when winning an apprentice race at Goodwood on Friday (1m, good to soft); unpenalised today and holds obvious claims despite a wide stall.

runners_data.name: Island Hero
runners_data.note: 285-day absence is major concern despite prominent style fitting the likely pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Unexposed 4yo but he has something to prove after another absence
runners_data.spotlight: Promising second in a Wolverhampton novice (8.6f) last January but he's struggled in both subsequent runs, including on handicap debut at Sandown (1m, soft) last August; still unexposed but he has plenty to prove after another absence; hooded first time.

runners_data.name: Freddie's Star
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in two handicaps after his maiden success; new trip needs to turn things round
runners_data.spotlight: Won a weak novice at Chelmsford in November (7f, AW; 1-16f); poor form in handicaps since and connections now turn to cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Criminal
runners_data.note: William Buick booking suggests confidence, hold-up style needs genuine pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Nearly won on the AW latest despite starting slowly; cheekpieces could work
runners_data.spotlight: 12-race maiden; had a near miss dropped into Class 5 company at Lingfield in April (1m2f); fair run on turf last month despite finishing last of the four runners; each-way shout.

runners_data.name: I Am Me
runners_data.note: Course winner whose prominent style is perfectly suited to tactical affair, 105-day break freshens him
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark for this yard with a last-gasp C&D win in February; a 3lb rise for that nose success leaves him vulnerable.

runners_data.name: Celestias Comet
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with headgear back on, ran yesterday so fitness assured but style may not suit
runners_data.comment: Won an uncompetitive fillies' novice at Southwell last September but hasn't built on it
runners_data.spotlight: She hasn't looked ahead of the handicapper following her small-field novice win at Southwell last September; dropping down the weights but arrives with plenty to prove; fifth 7.21 Brighton Tuesday.

runners_data.name: Billy Mill
runners_data.note: Consistent course performer whose hold-up style has thrived here recently, form solid
runners_data.comment: Eight-time AW winner who has finished placed over C&D in last two starts; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Prolific winner who arrives on the back of three placed efforts over C&D; now 2lb higher but likely to give his running once again.

runners_data.name: Havana Touch
runners_data.note: Course winner in April off lower mark, hold-up style needs luck in running from this large field
runners_data.comment: In top form on AW in the spring and key player if that continues back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Justified favouritism in a C&D handicap in April off 5lb lower; beaten a nose at Lingfield later that month and then met trouble in running at Ripon last week; should remain competitive.

runners_data.name: My Boy Harry
runners_data.note: In-form horse stepping up from 7f, 5lb weight advantage significant, hold-up style needs pace
runners_data.comment: Won latest (7f, good); possibly flattered but warrants respect under penalty; 1lb well in
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner; arrives in form, winning easily over 7f at Lingfield (good ground); solid third at Brighton 12 days ago and returning to 1m is no issue; this is a step up in class though.

runners_data.name: American State
runners_data.note: Met trouble last week so form hard to assess, hold-up runner needs everything to fall right
runners_data.comment: Southwell winner (1m; from 4lb lower) on penultimate start; low key at Wetherby since.
runners_data.spotlight: Two AW wins this year; met plenty of trouble when down the field at Newcastle last week but still makes only limited appeal tonight.

runners_data.name: Just Typical
runners_data.note: 5lb apprentice allowance valuable after 151-day break, slow-starting tendency is tactical negative
runners_data.spotlight: 1m turf win last September off 4lb lower; in and out since, often conceding ground at the start, but Ryan Kavanagh takes off a valuable 5lb; below his best in one Kempton appearance.

runners_data.name: Hour By Hour
runners_data.note: Prominent runner likely to lead if others don't go forward, stable debut disappointed three weeks ago
runners_data.comment: All four wins have been at 6f and has something to prove back up in trip for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Well treated on his 2024 form; low-key stable debut here three weeks ago and he arrives with a point to prove.

races.paceDynamic: With Freddie's Star withdrawn, this becomes a tactical affair lacking a confirmed front runner. Island Hero and Hour By Hour are the most likely pace-setters from their prominent styles, but neither is aggressive enough to create genuine tempo. The large field of hold-up horses including Criminal, Billy Mill, Havana Touch, and My Boy Harry will force a stop-start gallop over this sharp mile. This shape heavily favours prominent racers who can position close enough to strike, as the hold-up brigade will struggle for racing room in the sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Favours Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Island Hero or Hour By Hour set modest fractions with the field bunched behind
scenarios.body: The lack of pace allows prominent runners to settle perfectly positioned before the field compresses turning for home. Hold-up horses get trapped behind the wall of runners as the race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Holds Up
scenarios.trigger: If Island Hero goes forward more aggressively than expected and maintains honest gallop
scenarios.body: The stronger tempo stretches the field and creates gaps for the better hold-up horses to exploit in the final furlong. Billy Mill and Havana Touch can use their proven course form to good effect.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Silca Bay Strikes Again
scenarios.trigger: If the Goodwood winner can reproduce Friday's form despite quick turnaround
scenarios.body: His confidence from the recent win and unpenalised status allows him to overcome the 5-day gap between races. Oliver Carmichael's 7lb claim becomes decisive in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and an unconsidered runner finds clear passage
scenarios.body: The messy tactical race plays into the hands of a horse getting significant weight relief or returning from a break. American State or Just Typical benefit from the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Island Hero returning after 285 days could blow out early if fitness is lacking
Silca Bay racing for second time in 6 days may show effects of quick turnaround in final furlong
Criminal with William Buick represents stable confidence despite poor recent form
Multiple hold-up horses including Billy Mill and Havana Touch could get trapped if pace collapses completely
Just Typical often loses lengths at start which could prove costly in tactical race

races.name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier) (Div I)

runners_data.name: Rogue Supremacy
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits if pace materializes, Watson yard quiet but 16-day break looks ideal for sprint return
runners_data.comment: Two wins at about 5f as 2yo; no progress for new yard this year; gelded since last seen
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins for David O'Meara as a 2yo and also ran a cracker over C&D last September (Group 3); the handicapper has been in command this year but he returns to AW and drops back to a Class 4; not solid but a revival isn't out of the question.

runners_data.name: Siren Suit
runners_data.note: Needs strong pace to unleash late kick, 7-pound claimer adds pressure but going suits
runners_data.comment: Seasonal debutant who gained his 2yo win when fresh and may do better still
runners_data.spotlight: Finished a close third in a hot race at Ascot last April (closely matched with Angel Of Anfield) on his second start and had little trouble in seeing off eight rivals in a 7f maiden here last October; his two runs since, seven months apart, have resulted in heavy defeats; drops in class and could make a bold bid back on AW with Toby Moore taking off a handy 7lb.

runners_data.name: Angel Love
runners_data.note: Prominent style dangerous with traffic concerns, wide draw compounds tactical problems
runners_data.spotlight: Couldn't go overboard about the form of her Wolverhampton maiden win (6f) last November, for all it was by a wide margin; drawn wide when down the field at Chester on her seasonal/handicap debut five weeks ago; better berthed today but perhaps too high in the weights.

runners_data.name: Angel Of Anfield
runners_data.note: Lone leader has tactical gold mine, Clover yard struggling but this setup plays to strengths
runners_data.comment: All races at sprint trips, making all at Windsor in August; good AW run after; off since
runners_data.spotlight: Promising fifth on debut (closely matched with Siren Suit); beaten at odds-on twice afterwards but then made no mistake at Windsor last August (6f, good); close second over C&D on his nursery debut in October; dropped away in the closing stages at Ascot on his reappearance last month (7f, good) but returns to 6f, drops in class and is clearly at home on AW; should go well from a handy draw.

runners_data.name: Moonshine
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in congested pack, Walker stable in form but faces traffic nightmare
runners_data.comment: Return to 7f looks in order and she seems to have a competitive mark for handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in her first three starts; off the mark at the fourth attempt when winning a small-field fillies' novice over C&D in March; no improvement for handicaps at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) six weeks ago but still ran to form; others perhaps better treated.

runners_data.name: Jumeirah Sands
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid AW form, 5-pound claimer negative but recent wins show confidence
runners_data.comment: C&D success on reappearance, despite again starting slowly; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Market springer on her 2yo debut but on the back foot after a slow start and could only manage fifth; overcame another slow start to win a Southwell novice in April (6f) and she was sharper away when overcoming a penalty back at Southwell five weeks ago; needs more now handicapping and she's drawn widest but her ceiling may not have been reached.

runners_data.name: Marengo Storm
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits race shape, Buick booking significant and C&D winner last time
runners_data.comment: Good win latest and brings lots of potential to his h'cap debut; first go on turf; player
runners_data.spotlight: Stepped up on his debut (C&D) when readily accounting for nine rivals in a C&D maiden last month; couldn't reward favourite backers at Windsor on his handicap debut 18 days ago but it was still a sound effort in second, keeping on well in the final furlong (third has won since); up 3lb but doubt he has reached his ceiling.

runners_data.name: Deluded
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who could benefit from chaos, 26-day break concern for sprint fitness
runners_data.comment: Won 7f AW maiden as 2yo; just failed on handicap debut latest; up 3lb but can improve
runners_data.spotlight: 7f AW win last September; good second at Wolverhampton on his reappearance but he was a well-beaten third at Newmarket last month (7f, good); others look stronger.

runners_data.name: The Lost Sock
runners_data.note: Prominent style faces traffic problems, expensive to follow in handicaps this season
runners_data.comment: Little impression before he was hampered last time but it is too soon to write him off
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 5f maiden at Catterick last summer; expensive to follow in handicaps this year and the step back up to 6f isn't enough to tempt.

runners_data.name: Arry Up
runners_data.note: Double C&D winner but prominent style puts him in danger zone with three others
runners_data.comment: Big boy who's firmly on the up; landed hat-trick latest and fancied to complete four-timer
runners_data.spotlight: Ended his 2yo campaign with a Leicester nursery win; further progress with his two C&D wins in early April; well beaten in a big-field Ascot handicap in his bid for a four-timer last month; career-best effort required.

races.paceDynamic: Angel Of Anfield stands alone as the confirmed front runner and should secure an uncontested lead in this 6f sprint. The prominent congestion comes from Angel Love, Moonshine, The Lost Sock, and Arry Up all wanting that tactical position, creating traffic problems entering the final 3f. With only one natural leader, Angel Of Anfield can dictate terms and steal a march on the field before the prominent runners can organize their challenge. This race shape strongly favours the lone leader and hold-up horses who can find clear water late - the prominent runners face the biggest tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Scores
scenarios.trigger: If Angel Of Anfield breaks cleanly and establishes an easy lead without pressure.
scenarios.body: Angel Of Anfield gets first run on the field while prominent runners tangle behind him, allowing him to kick clear when the real pace arrives. The soft lead gives him energy reserves to resist late challengers who leave their runs too late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet creates early pace pressure and compromises each other.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuine as Angel Love, Moonshine, The Lost Sock, and Arry Up jostle for position, setting up the race for closers. Hold-up horses like Rogue Supremacy and Siren Suit get perfect pace conditions to unleash late finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners secures the perfect stalking position without traffic.
scenarios.body: A single prominent horse avoids the early congestion and tracks Angel Of Anfield in the clear, getting first shot at the leader turning for home. The tactical advantage of a clean trip trumps the pace disadvantage in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If severe early pace and traffic problems compromise all the fancied runners.
scenarios.body: Multiple incidents in the prominent pack create a messy race where the winner comes from an unexpected source. A horse with the right trip at the right time capitalizes on others' misfortune to spring a surprise.

watchPoints.text: Angel Of Anfield's break from the stalls - if he misses it, the whole race dynamic changes and prominent runners seize control
The first two furlongs where Angel Love, Moonshine, The Lost Sock, and Arry Up could create a pace meltdown fighting for position
William Buick's tactics on Marengo Storm - if he gets aggressive early it signals strong confidence from the Hughes yard
Siren Suit's position turning for home - needs to be in the first four to have any chance of delivering his finishing kick
How much daylight Rogue Supremacy can find in the straight - his kick is sharp but needs racing room to be effective

races.name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Sprint Series Qualifier) (Div II)

runners_data.name: Front Line Fury
runners_data.note: Natural front runner returning to AW where he may find conditions more suitable than recent turf efforts
runners_data.comment: Two 6f wins as 2yo; never involved on first run since wind op; now tongue tied
runners_data.spotlight: Not matched his 2yo best in two runs this year but he drops into a Class 4 and today's switch to AW could suit; well treated if reviving.

runners_data.name: Sayidah Hard Spun
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong C&D record including Group 3 form, well suited by expected strong pace
runners_data.comment: Two 6f wins as a 2yo; low-key reappearance in April; needs to take a big step forward
runners_data.spotlight: She ran well in both C&D starts last year, winning a fillies' novice last May and a close fifth in a Group 3 in September; well held in two turf handicaps this year, the latest nine days ago, but drops in class today and a revival isn't out of the question.

runners_data.name: Angel Gabriel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making handicap debut after December win, gelding operation may have sharpened him up
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt as a 2yo, making most at Lingfield in December (6f); gelded soon after; makes his handicap debut at a realistic level and he is one to take seriously.

runners_data.name: Generous Rascal
runners_data.note: Likes to race prominently and has winning C&D form, but needs to improve on recent AW efforts
runners_data.comment: Won 6f AW novice for Oliver Cole; encouraging handicap third on stable debut last month
runners_data.spotlight: C&D win for Oliver Cole last October; he hasn't run badly two 6f handicaps for this yard but improvement is needed now returned to AW.

runners_data.name: Exotic Baby
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse dropping to 6f for first time, may benefit from shorter trip and sustained early pace
runners_data.comment: Stopped quickly on turf debut 19 days ago; much safer elsewhere
runners_data.spotlight: 1m win as a 2yo; the handicapper has held the upper hand since and hopes appear to rest on the drop to 6f having a positive effect.

runners_data.name: Deported
runners_data.note: Needs the drop to 6f to work in his favour having shown promise over longer trips
runners_data.comment: Good fourth on handicap debut at Southwell last month; holds solid claims back at 7f
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in five runs over further; drop in trip asks a new question of him and he needs to benefit from it.

runners_data.name: Big Harry
runners_data.note: Front runner returning from 214-day break with strong 2yo form including comfortable 6f success
runners_data.spotlight: Improved with each of his three 2yo runs, making all for a comfortable success at Doncaster in November (6f, heavy); that form has been advertised by the second and third and he moves into handicaps off a tempting mark; absent seven months but well drawn and he's an interesting contender.

runners_data.name: Amazing Journey
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has struggled with starts recently but showed promise in Leicester return
runners_data.spotlight: Two 6f wins last summer but things haven't gone to plan since, often compromising his chance at the start; last month's return to action at Leicester was promising, though, and he's almost certainly better than this mark should the stars align.

runners_data.name: Sir Alfie
runners_data.note: Previously effective when making the running but has been well beaten in recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Two wins last summer for Ger Lyons but he's struggled more recently; a tongue-tie goes on
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice for Ger Lyons last summer, making all in a 6f handicap at the Curragh last August; well beaten in two runs for Charles Byrnes last autumn and he hasn't fired in three runs for his new connections either; latest York run was slightly more encouraging so he's worth a market check dropping into a Class 4 and returning to 6f.

runners_data.name: Seu Jo
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with tendency to fade late, making this strong early pace a concern
runners_data.comment: Looks best watched having struggled on British debut 19 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: 1m AW win in France in March; big prices and well beaten in two runs for new connections; may need some more help from the handicapper.

races.paceDynamic: Front Line Fury and Big Harry are both confirmed front runners who will lock horns from the gates, ensuring a genuine early gallop over this sharp 6f trip. With Angel Gabriel and Generous Rascal likely to sit prominent behind the leading pair, the pace will be honest throughout with no let-up. The strong early tempo will set up the race for those with finishing kick from midfield or further back. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can unleash late speed, as the front runners will soften each other up in a sustained battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Early Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Front Line Fury and Big Harry both jump well and engage in a pace duel from the start.
scenarios.body: The relentless early gallop will drain both leaders and create perfect conditions for closers to strike late. Hold-up horses like Sayidah Hard Spun and Exotic Baby can time their runs to perfection as the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Front Line Fury or Big Harry gets an uncontested lead while the other misses the break or settles.
scenarios.body: The lone leader controls the fractions and may have enough left to resist late challenges on the slower going. Prominent runners can track the moderate pace and challenge strongly in the straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If both main pace setters are slowly away or tactical, creating a false early tempo.
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows more horses to get competitive positions and turns it into a sprint finish. This brings stamina-shy types back into contention as they won't face the searching gallop expected.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners Angel Gabriel or Generous Rascal take over from faltering leaders at halfway.
scenarios.body: The change of pace in mid-race catches some off guard while suiting those with tactical speed. This scenario can favor horses that need the race to unfold at a steady rhythm before quickening.

watchPoints.text: Big Harry returning after 214 days off - watch if he shows any signs of rustiness or blows up late after making early running
Front Line Fury and Big Harry both breaking from the gates together - if one is significantly slower away it changes the entire pace scenario
Amazing Journey at the start - his recent issues getting away cleanly could compromise his hold-up style in a race where position matters
Sayidah Hard Spun's positioning early - she needs to be within striking distance to capitalize on the expected pace collapse
The pace after 2f - if it's not as strong as expected, the hold-up horses lose their key advantage

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Club Class
runners_data.note: Hold-up Frankel filly with strong C&D form and Buick's tactical expertise, though 37 days off needs consideration
runners_data.comment: Behind two of these on last month's reappearance here; return to 1m4f should help
runners_data.spotlight: Gained a breakthrough victory over C&D in September and she has resumed in good form, fourth of seven over C&D last month; this Frankel filly may do better still (lost shoe last time) so is a likely player eased 1lb.

runners_data.name: Caramay
runners_data.note: Reliable hold-up performer with excellent similar going record (13/15), but trainer having a quiet spell recently
runners_data.comment: Consistent AW handicapper; faces difficult task off current mark back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Resumed winning ways over 1m3f here in February and in good form since, not seen to ideal effect when fifth of nine in 1m4f Goodwood handicap 19 days ago; she ought to be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Shushi
runners_data.note: Prominent racer dropping 3lbs after consistent placed efforts, though relatively inexperienced at just four career runs
runners_data.spotlight: Camelot filly who has made the frame on all her four runs, posting a fair fourth on her handicap debut at Doncaster (1m4f) last time; no forlorn hope off a 3lb lower mark.

runners_data.name: Golden Muse
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with back-to-back AW wins earlier this year, returning after 46-day break with strong recent work
runners_data.comment: Bagged novices at Wolverhampton and Southwell; capable of better on h'cap/turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Bagged back-to-back novices at Wolverhampton (9.5f) and Southwell (1m4f) in March before advancing her form on her first go in handicaps with a clear third of six at Doncaster (1m2f) in April; this Golden Horn filly has more to offer, especially now back up in trip; major player.

runners_data.name: Soleil d'Arizona
runners_data.note: Ex-French front-runner returning from hurdles after 31 days, major question mark over fitness and distance suitability
runners_data.comment: Skelton mare who is interesting off a workable mark back down in class
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-French 1m3f Flat scorer; a fair 2m winning hurdler for her current yard in 2025 but she was tailed off in 2m Ludlow handicap hurdle last month; needs to take a big step forward on her first Flat run since 2023.

runners_data.name: Desert Belle
runners_data.note: Front-running three-year-old with promising Southwell win, though handicap debut was below par and may need more time
runners_data.comment: Stepped up in trip to score at Southwell (1m4f) last month; makes handicap debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark at the second attempt in 1m4f Southwell novice in April; still looked a work in progress when fourth of five on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f) 23 days ago; this Masar filly remains with potential.

runners_data.name: Possible
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning from ten-month layoff with new connections, stamina proven but fitness a major concern
runners_data.comment: Placed over 2m, 1m3f and 1m4f last May/June on the last three of her four starts in France
runners_data.spotlight: Fair ex-French maiden (stays 2m) for Francis-Henri Graffard in the first half of 2025; off ten months before coming in a well-held ninth for her new yard in 1m4f Newbury handicap 26 days ago; should strip sharper here.

runners_data.name: Too Farhh Gone
runners_data.note: Progressive prominent racer in good recent form, though stepping up significantly in class from maiden company
runners_data.comment: Dug deep to win a Southwell novice last month (1m3f); faces tougher task now handicapping
runners_data.spotlight: Steadily progressive daughter of Farhh; gained a first win in 1m3f Southwell maiden in April and backed it up with a good fourth of ten on her handicap debut at Salisbury (1m4f) 18 days ago; not out of things on her Polytrack debut.

runners_data.name: Jindri
runners_data.note: Hold-up winner last time but absent 202 days, needs to reproduce Southwell form fresh from a lengthy seasonal break
runners_data.comment: 0-5 but has shown ability; extra furlong should be within range and she remains unexposed
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who got off the mark at the sixth attempt in 1m4f handicap at Southwell in November; off since so she needs to hit the ground running on her seasonal return.

races.paceDynamic: Golden Muse, Soleil d'Arizona, and Desert Belle will ensure a strong gallop from the start over this stamina-testing 1m4f trip. Golden Muse has early pace and form at the distance, while Soleil d'Arizona returns from hurdles with natural front-running instincts, and Desert Belle showed speed when winning at Southwell. The sustained tempo will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the straight. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish powerfully, as the early burn will set up a closing kick for patient rides.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a genuine pace throughout
scenarios.body: The strong tempo will find out the stamina reserves of prominent racers and set up perfect conditions for the hold-up brigade to finish strongly in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets loose on the lead
scenarios.body: Golden Muse or Desert Belle could exploit any tactical errors by getting first run and holding on, especially if the hold-up horses are caught napping or traffic-affected.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong but not suicidal
scenarios.body: Horses like Shushi and Too Farhh Gone positioned just behind the leaders can strike at the perfect moment, avoiding both the early burn and any late traffic problems.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners compromise each other's speed early
scenarios.body: Without sustained pressure, the race becomes a sprint finish where any horse can win regardless of position, though this seems unlikely given the natural pace in the field.

watchPoints.text: Soleil d'Arizona's fitness after 31 days off hurdles - any market support suggests connections confident but form transfer uncertain
Golden Muse and Desert Belle could engage in a pace duel early that compromises both their winning chances
Club Class needs Buick to find the right position from her wide draw to utilize her strong finishing kick
Jindri returning after 202 days off - watch for any signs of ring-rustiness in the preliminaries
Too Farhh Gone stepping up markedly in class - her recent Southwell form may not translate to this level

races.name: Unibet Supports Safer Gambling Handicap (London Middle Distance Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Wood Whisperer
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 53 days off for struggling trainer Pike, going very freely last time suggests temperament concerns
runners_data.comment: Travelled well for a long way over 1m3f on AW latest; remains unexposed after six starts
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some fair form for Paul Attwater in 2025 but has failed to build on it for his present yard, going very freely when 12th in 1m2f handicap at Nottingham in April; has since been gelded.

runners_data.name: Sea Of Charm
runners_data.note: Won over C&D in January but disappointing since, needs significant step forward from recent Chepstow sixth
runners_data.comment: Has won on AW this year but didn't fire when back on turf this month; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with 1m4f AW victory at Lingfield but her more recent form is not so encouraging, sixth of eight in 1m4f Chepstow handicap 12 days ago; more is required in a change of headgear.

runners_data.name: Golspie
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse in excellent form with three placings from last four starts, well-handicapped
runners_data.comment: Better than his last run and could go well if as effective at 1m3f and on softer going
runners_data.spotlight: Kept busy in 2026 and running well without winning, in the frame for the sixth time with third of nine in 1m2f Haydock handicap 19 days ago; not out of things on his Polytrack debut.

runners_data.name: Imperial Cult
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who broke long losing streak at Lingfield, up 3lb but retains strong each-way claims from forward position
runners_data.comment: Reappearance win took AW record to 3-15; only 1-21 on turf but is on a workable mark
runners_data.spotlight: Gained a first win since 2024 when landing gamble for his new yard in 1m4f handicap at Lingfield in April; back up 3lb but remains handily weighted on past form so merits serious consideration.

runners_data.name: Man From Havana
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced handicap debutant returning from 238 days off, went too freely in maidens and needs to settle better
runners_data.comment: Handicap newcomer and he's a possible improver upped in trip on his return
runners_data.spotlight: Very lightly raced Havana Grey gelding; went too freely when seventh of 11 in 1m Nottingham maiden in October; returns for his handicap debut with more needed.

runners_data.name: Running The Game
runners_data.note: Course winner but returning from 479 days off, market will reveal fitness levels for this comeback
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner in January, 2024; lightly raced since though and has his fitness to prove returning from 15 months off; the market can guide.

runners_data.name: Sonnerie Power
runners_data.note: Won over C&D for new connections, consistent hold-up performer but faces traffic concerns from deep
runners_data.comment: Winning stable debut (1m3f, Polytrack) in January and held his form since; down in class
runners_data.spotlight: Made a winning start for current yard over C&D in January and has continued in good nick, set a lot to do when sixth of 15 in 1m4f Lingfield handicap in April; in the mix once more.

runners_data.name: Uzincso
runners_data.note: Veteran 10-year-old who won over C&D in September, encouraging fourth here three weeks ago suggests retention of ability
runners_data.comment: Seven-time course winner but he's been out of sorts in last four runs; down the list
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran who garnered a seventh victory here over C&D in September; took a step back in the right direction with fourth of 11 in 1m4f handicap here three weeks ago; well in the mix eased 1lb.

runners_data.name: Karakula
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in excellent current form with narrow second last time, 7lb claimer reduces burden
runners_data.comment: Second over C&D last month and the booking of Oisin Murphy may be significant.
runners_data.spotlight: Gained a first win at Wolverhampton (9.5f) in September; has resumed in excellent form, not enjoying the smoothest of passages when beaten a short head in another 9.5f Wolverhampton handicap 23 days ago; a likely player back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Semele
runners_data.note: Struggling since encouraging C&D fourth in March, failed to build on promise in recent outings
runners_data.comment: Balance of bumper/hurdles form suggests she has something to find
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form shown in three bumpers; has twice failed to build on an encouraging C&D maiden fourth in March, coming in last of ten in 1m2f Nottingham novice 22 days ago; lots more required now going handicapping.

runners_data.name: St Just In Time
runners_data.note: Still a maiden who beat only one on return from 15 months off, major improvement required
runners_data.comment: Went close over hurdles when last seen; market useful back from over a year off
runners_data.spotlight: Still a maiden and he beat only one on his return from 15 months off for his new yard in 1m3f Southwell handicap 20 days ago; needs to take a major step forward.

runners_data.name: Blackwaterfoot
runners_data.note: Got off the mark at Ffos Las but poor subsequent form, returning from 230 days layoff under suspicion
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark in 1m2f Ffos Las handicap but well below that form in handicaps (around 1m2f) at Wolverhampton and Nottingham for Paul Attwater later last summer; needs yard switch to spark a resurgence after seven months off.

runners_data.name: Pershalla
runners_data.note: Only natural front-runner who won over C&D in April, disappointing at Windsor but can redeem with uncontested lead
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced; improved for step up to 1m4f/hood when winning on AW; creditable 2nd since
runners_data.spotlight: Got off the mark over 1m4f here in April but she came in a below-par seventh of ten in 11.5f Windsor handicap 30 days ago; needs to get back on track.

runners_data.name: Three Yorkshiremen
runners_data.note: Previous course winner but well below par in three runs this season, hard to recommend
runners_data.spotlight: Took this in 2025 for Michael Wigham; also won for Barry Brennan at Wolverhampton in November but well below par in three runs for that yard this season; starts out for another stable here with something to prove.

races.paceDynamic: Pershalla is the sole confirmed front-runner and will be allowed to dictate terms without pressure through the early stages. Imperial Cult, Uzincso and Karakula may track prominently but none are natural pace-setters, allowing Pershalla to bowl along at sustainable fractions. The large field of hold-up horses including Sea Of Charm, Golspie, Wood Whisperer and Sonnerie Power will be bunched behind, creating potential traffic problems in the straight. This uncontested lead scenario strongly favours front-running and prominent racers who can secure early position and avoid the inevitable scramble from deep.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pershalla sets comfortable fractions without early pressure from the prominent trio
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal splits and kick clear when the field starts its move, while the massed ranks of hold-up horses get caught in traffic. The lack of pace pressure allows her stamina to tell over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Imperial Cult or Uzincso sit close enough to Pershalla to strike when she weakens
scenarios.body: The experienced duo can use their tactical speed to pounce when the leader comes back to them in the final furlong. Their forward positions avoid the hold-up horse traffic while benefiting from the honest pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Weaves Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: One of the classier hold-up horses like Sea Of Charm or Golspie finds racing room and uses superior finishing speed. The slow tempo would suit their profiles but requires significant luck in running.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Pershalla goes too slow early and multiple horses challenge simultaneously in a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where any horse with a clear run can prevail through sheer fortune. Form and class become secondary to racing luck in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Pershalla could steal this race if allowed uncontested fractions - monitor if any prominent horses challenge her early position
Traffic problems likely in straight with 11 hold-up horses bunched together - watch for clear runs developing late
Imperial Cult and Uzincso both need to track close enough to strike when leader weakens - their early positioning crucial
Running The Game returning from 15-month absence - market support would indicate hidden fitness levels
Apprentice Toby Moore(7) on Karakula reduces weight to 132lbs, significant advantage if horse reproduces recent form
